raw_response_text:
{
  "project_id": "P-PER-ArequipaColca",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "GORE Arequipa lacks experience with World Bank‑financed projects, risking fiduciary and implementation shortcomings.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Provide targeted capacity‑building, early recruitment of key staff, and close supervision on fiduciary and environmental safeguards.",
      "evidence": "GORE does not have experience implementing WB‑financed projects, so capacity building and close supervision will be required."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Delayed recruitment of financial management staff could postpone project start‑up and disbursements.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Prepare terms of reference early and appoint all FM positions, including FM specialist, within two months of effectiveness.",
      "evidence": "Delayed recruitment of FM staff... all the FM staff shall be appointed within two months after effectiveness."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "Budget allocation and execution delays common in Peru may hinder project readiness and cash flow.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Initiate budget allocation immediately after loan signing and follow the Project Operations Manual for timely execution.",
      "evidence": "initial project implementation phases often experience delays in budget allocation and low budget execution rates."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Inaccurate accounting and financial reporting due to limited experience with WB procedures.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Use the national accounting system (SIAF), conduct annual independent audits, and train staff on WB financial standards.",
      "evidence": "Potential inaccuracies in accounting and financial reporting... national accounting system (SIAF) will be used... supplemented by annual independent audits."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Fragmented coordination among ministries, municipalities and private sector may cause implementation delays.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Establish high‑level steering and consultative committees with clear TORs, schedule regular meetings and joint decision‑making.",
      "evidence": "high‑level steering and consultative committees are expected to be formed to oversee and support project implementation."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Climate‑related hazards (floods, landslides, earthquakes) could damage roads and heritage sites.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Incorporate climate‑resilient designs, slope stabilization, drainage, and consider insurance schemes for high‑risk assets.",
      "evidence": "main climate and natural hazard risks... heavy rains, flooding, landslides, high seismic activity."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Construction in landslide‑prone zones may lead to cost overruns and schedule slips.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Conduct detailed geotechnical surveys, avoid high‑risk alignments, and apply engineered mitigation measures where unavoidable.",
      "evidence": "Subcomponent 2.1 addresses the vulnerability of transportation infrastructure to floods and landslides."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Water and sanitation upgrades may lack sustainable operation & maintenance, reducing service quality.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Develop O&M manuals, train local operators, and establish dedicated maintenance funds for the new facilities.",
      "evidence": "project will support arrangements that ensure mechanisms are in place for the ongoing maintenance and sustainability of the improved assets."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Reforestation targets may not be achieved, limiting carbon‑sequestration benefits.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Implement robust monitoring, involve community groups in planting and care, and secure funding for seedlings and maintenance.",
      "evidence": "Reforestation of Bosque de Queñua is completed... mitigation measures include reforestation of degraded forest areas."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Risk of sexual exploitation, abuse and harassment affecting women participants and project reputation.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Enforce the SEA/SH Action Plan, provide mandatory training, and operate a grievance mechanism with swift response.",
      "evidence": "project’s action plan on sexual exploitation and abuse (SEA) and sexual harassment (SH) will address barriers."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Procurement of numerous small works may not fully comply with World Bank procurement rules.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Follow WB Procurement Regulations, use standard documents, and conduct internal procurement reviews before award.",
      "evidence": "Project procurement will follow the World Bank’s ‘Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers’."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Private investors may postpone commitments if public infrastructure is delayed or of insufficient quality.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Align public works timelines with private investment pipelines, provide clear investment opportunities, and use Obras por Impuestos incentives.",
      "evidence": "private sector ... is willing to invest once they see that infrastructure and tourism offerings are upgraded."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Tourism demand forecasts could be overly optimistic, reducing projected economic returns.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Conduct periodic demand reviews, adjust marketing strategies, and diversify tourism products to mitigate shortfalls.",
      "evidence": "Market demand analysis indicates substantial tourism growth potential... projected growth rates."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Recent political instability may affect government commitment and funding continuity.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Secure multi‑year budget commitments, embed the project in legal frameworks, and maintain high‑level political advocacy.",
      "evidence": "increased political instability in recent years."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R15",
      "description": "High road fatality rate raises safety risks for construction crews and future road users.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Implement strict safety protocols, worker training, traffic management plans, and install road safety features (guardrails, markings).",
      "evidence": "Arequipa region has sustained a higher road fatality rate... designs will also include road safety features."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R16",
      "description": "Construction of the Yura health centre may experience cost overruns or schedule delays.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Develop a detailed construction schedule with contingencies, monitor progress weekly, and allocate a cost contingency reserve.",
      "evidence": "subcomponent 2.3 Health ... finance demolition of the existing health clinic, construction of a larger clinic."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R17",
      "description": "Disbursement is blocked until three Interinstitutional Agreements are signed, risking cash‑flow gaps.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Negotiate agreements early, set internal deadlines, and monitor signing status to meet the Bank’s condition.",
      "evidence": "No withdrawals shall be made ... unless the Bank has received at least three signed Interinstitutional Agreements."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R18",
      "description": "Work in Salinas and Aguada Blanca National Reserve may breach protected‑area regulations.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Obtain SERNANP approvals, prepare an Environmental and Social Management Plan, and conduct regular compliance monitoring.",
      "evidence": "coordination with SERNANP for work in the Salinas and Aguada Blanca National Reserve."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R19",
      "description": "Capacity‑building activities may not translate into effective destination management.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Include post‑training coaching, performance indicators, and periodic evaluations of institutional capacity gains.",
      "evidence": "capacity building for destination management will focus on strengthening the capacity of GORE."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R20",
      "description": "M&E data may be incomplete or inaccurate due to reliance on surveys and remote‑sensing methods.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Establish robust data‑collection protocols, backup data sources, and conduct regular data‑quality audits.",
      "evidence": "Monitoring will leverage data collection mechanisms from existing sources ... will include dedicated surveys."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R21",
      "description": "Existing gender wage gap may limit women’s economic benefits despite project interventions.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Provide targeted entrepreneurship training, monitor gender‑wage indicators, and promote women‑led enterprises in tourism.",
      "evidence": "Peru also has a large gender wage gap, estimated at 25 percent in 2021."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R22",
      "description": "Failure to create and staff the PIU within 60 days breaches loan covenants.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Prepare a recruitment plan with clear timelines and monitor staffing milestones against the covenant deadline.",
      "evidence": "personnel to be hired ... no later than sixty (60) days after the Effective Date."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R23",
      "description": "Accelerating climate change may exceed design assumptions, shortening asset lifespan.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Incorporate adaptive management, periodic climate‑risk reassessments, and design with safety margins.",
      "evidence": "climate change will likely exacerbate existing regional disparities by increasing the impacts and frequency of natural hazards."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R24",
      "description": "Potential conflicts with indigenous communities over land or cultural sites could delay works.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Conduct Free, Prior and Informed Consent (FPIC) processes and engage communities early in project planning.",
      "evidence": "FPIC; Indigenous Peoples Plan (IPP) listed among abbreviations."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R25",
      "description": "Historically low budget execution rates may reduce available funds for project components.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Implement strict budget tracking, quarterly execution reviews, and incentives for timely spending.",
      "evidence": "initial project implementation phases often experience delays in budget allocation and low budget execution rates."
    }
  ]
}
